suppress.notes: Reviewed 2026-09-02. CVE-2025-21199 applies to Microsoft Azure Agent Installer products under the CPE family cpe:2.3:a:microsoft:azure_agent:* and the NVD affected-software entries are for the "backup" and "site_recovery" products. This repo contains the Java libraries com.microsoft.azure:applicationinsights-core and com.microsoft.azure:applicationinsights-web, which are being mapped to the generic azure_agent CPE by Dependency-Check. No newer com.microsoft.azure:applicationinsights-web release is currently available beyond 3.7.9. Keep this suppression only for that false-positive CPE match.
False positive: CVE-2025-15104 applies to Nu Html Checker (validator.nu), not com.networknt:json-schema-validator.

False positive: CVE-2026-33117 affects the Azure Java Key Vault Keys library's cryptographic verification path, not the Azure Core, AMQP, HTTP Netty, JSON, or Identity modules used here. Dependency-Check maps these modules to the generic microsoft:azure_sdk_for_java CPE.
False positive: CVE-2023-36415 is not applicable to the Java Azure Identity library; Dependency-Check has matched an unrelated Azure Identity product.
False positive for the resolved versions: CVE-2024-35255 affects Azure Identity versions below 1.12.2 and MSAL4J versions below 1.15.1. This project resolves azure-identity 1.17.0 and msal4j 1.22.0.
